import type { FreeCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function attachBigWorldFly(camera: FreeCamera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, scene: SceneContext): () => void {
    const FACTOR = 20;
    
    const originalSpeed = camera.speed;
    const angularSensitivity = camera.angularSensitivity;
    const inertia = camera.inertia;
    
    // Keyboard state
    const heldKeys = new Set<string>();
    
    // Mouse look state
    let dragging = false;
    let lastX = 0;
    let lastY = 0;
    let yawVel = 0;
    let pitchVel = 0;
    
    // The threshold for stopping look inertia (same as default)
    const lookThreshold = originalSpeed * 0.001;
    
    // Keyboard handler
    function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
        heldKeys.add(e.code);
        e.preventDefault();
    }
    function onKeyUp(e: KeyboardEvent) {
        heldKeys.delete(e.code);
    }
    
    // Mouse handlers
    function onPointerDown(e: PointerEvent) {
        if (e.button === 0 || e.button === 1 || e.button === 2) {
            dragging = true;
            lastX = e.clientX;
            lastY = e.clientY;
            canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        }
    }
    function onPointerMove(e: PointerEvent) {
        if (!dragging) return;
        const dx = e.clientX - lastX;
        const dy = e.clientY - lastY;
        lastX = e.clientX;
        lastY = e.clientY;
        yawVel += dx / angularSensitivity;
        pitchVel += dy / angularSensitivity;
    }
    function onPointerUp(e: PointerEvent) {
        dragging = false;
        canvas.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    }
    
    // Per-frame update
    let lastTime = performance.now();
    let rafId: number;
    
    function frame() {
        const now = performance.now();
        const deltaMs = Math.max(now - lastTime, 1);
        lastTime = now;
        
        // Keyboard movement (20x)
        const moveAmount = FACTOR * originalSpeed * deltaMs / Math.sqrt(100000);
        
        // Compute direction from _yaw and _pitch
        const yaw = camera._yaw;
        const pitch = camera._pitch;
        
        // Forward direction (includes pitch)
        const fx = Math.sin(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch);
        const fy = Math.sin(pitch);
        const fz = Math.cos(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch);
        
        // Right direction (horizontal only)
        const rx = Math.cos(yaw);
        const ry = 0;
        const rz = -Math.sin(yaw);
        
        let mx = 0, my = 0, mz = 0;
        
        if (heldKeys.has('KeyW') || heldKeys.has('ArrowUp')) {
            mx += fx * moveAmount;
            my += fy * moveAmount;
            mz += fz * moveAmount;
        }
        if (heldKeys.has('KeyS') || heldKeys.has('ArrowDown')) {
            mx -= fx * moveAmount;
            my -= fy * moveAmount;
            mz -= fz * moveAmount;
        }
        if (heldKeys.has('KeyA') || heldKeys.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            mx -= rx * moveAmount;
            mz -= rz * moveAmount;
        }
        if (heldKeys.has('KeyD') || heldKeys.has('ArrowRight')) {
            mx += rx * moveAmount;
            mz += rz * moveAmount;
        }
        if (heldKeys.has('Space') || heldKeys.has('PageUp')) {
            my += moveAmount;
        }
        if (heldKeys.has('ShiftLeft') || heldKeys.has('ShiftRight') || heldKeys.has('PageDown')) {
            my -= moveAmount;
        }
        
        if (mx !== 0 || my !== 0 || mz !== 0) {
            // Move position and target by the same amount (note 69)
            camera.position.x += mx;
            camera.position.y += my;
            camera.position.z += mz;
            camera.target.x += mx;
            camera.target.y += my;
            camera.target.z += mz;
        }
        
        // Mouse look
        if (Math.abs(yawVel) > lookThreshold || Math.abs(pitchVel) > lookThreshold) {
            camera._yaw += yawVel;
            camera._pitch += pitchVel;
            
            // Clamp pitch
            const maxPitch = Math.PI / 2 - 0.01;
            if (camera._pitch > maxPitch) camera._pitch = maxPitch;
            if (camera._pitch < -maxPitch) camera._pitch = -maxPitch;
            
            // Rebuild target from yaw/pitch
            const dist = 1; // target is 1 unit ahead (note 5)
            camera.target.x = camera.position.x + Math.sin(camera._yaw) * Math.cos(camera._pitch) * dist;
            camera.target.y = camera.position.y + Math.sin(camera._pitch) * dist;
            camera.target.z = camera.position.z + Math.cos(camera._yaw) * Math.cos(camera._pitch) * dist;

```typescript
import type { FreeCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";

export function attachBigWorldFly(camera: FreeCamera, canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, scene: SceneContext): () => void {
    const FACTOR = 20;
    
    const origSpeed = camera.speed;
    const angSens = camera.angularSensitivity;
    const inertia = camera.inertia;
    const lookThreshold = origSpeed * 0.001;
    
    // Keyboard state
    const held = new Set<string>();
    
    // Movement velocity (for keyboard)
    let mvx = 0, mvy = 0, mvz = 0;
    
    // Mouse look state
    let dragging = false;
    let lastX = 0, lastY = 0;
    let yawVel = 0, pitchVel = 0;
    
    // --- Keyboard handlers ---
    function onKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
        held.add(e.code);
        e.preventDefault();
    }
    function onKeyUp(e: KeyboardEvent): void {
        held.delete(e.code);
    }
    
    // --- Mouse handlers ---
    function onPointerDown(e: PointerEvent): void {
        if (e.button === 0 || e.button === 1 || e.button === 2) {
            dragging = true;
            lastX = e.clientX;
            lastY = e.clientY;
            canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        }
    }
    function onPointerMove(e: PointerEvent): void {
        if (!dragging) return;
        const dx = e.clientX - lastX;
        const dy = e.clientY - lastY;
        lastX = e.clientX;
        lastY = e.clientY;
        yawVel += dx / angSens;
        pitchVel += dy / angSens;
    }
    function onPointerUp(e: PointerEvent): void {
        dragging = false;
        if (canvas.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId)) {
            canvas.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        }
    }
    function onPointerCancel(e: PointerEvent): void {
        dragging = false;
        if (canvas.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId)) {
            canvas.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
        }
    }
    
    // --- Per-frame update ---
    let lastTime = performance.now();
    let rafId = 0;
    
    function frame(): void {
        const now = performance.now();
        const dt = Math.max(now - lastTime, 1);
        lastTime = now;
        
        // Keyboard movement (20x)
        const accel = FACTOR * origSpeed * dt / Math.sqrt(100000);
        
        const yaw = camera._yaw;
        const pitch = camera._pitch;
        
        // Forward (includes pitch)
        const fx = Math.sin(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch);
        const fy = Math.sin(pitch);
        const fz = Math.cos(yaw) * Math.cos(pitch);
        
        // Right (horizontal)
        const rx = Math.cos(yaw);
        const rz = -Math.sin(yaw);
        
        let ax = 0, ay = 0, az = 0;
        
        if (held.has('KeyW') || held.has('ArrowUp')) {
            ax += fx * accel; ay += fy * accel; az += fz * accel;
        }
        if (held.has('KeyS') || held.has('ArrowDown')) {
            ax -= fx * accel; ay -= fy * accel; az -= fz * accel;
        }
        if (held.has('KeyA') || held.has('ArrowLeft')) {
            ax -= rx * accel; az -= rz * accel;
        }
        if (held.has('KeyD') || held.has('ArrowRight')) {
            ax += rx * accel; az += rz * accel;
        }
        if (held.has('Space') || held.has('PageUp')) {
            ay += accel;
        }
        if (held.has('ShiftLeft') || held.has('ShiftRight') || held.has('PageDown')) {
            ay -= accel;
        }
        
        if (ax !== 0 || ay !== 0 || az !== 0) {
            mvx += ax; mvy += ay; mvz += az;
        }
        
        if (mvx !== 0 || mvy !== 0 || mvz !== 0) {
            camera.position.x += mvx;
            camera.position.y += mvy;
            camera.position.z += mvz;
            camera.target.x += mvx;
            camera.target.y += mvy;
            camera.target.z += mvz;
            mvx *= inertia;
            mvy *= inertia;
            mvz *= inertia;
            // Snap to zero if very small
            if (Math.abs(mvx) < 1e-10) mvx = 0;
            if (Math.abs(mvy) < 1e-10) mvy = 0;
            if (Math.abs(mvz) < 1e-10) mvz = 0;
        }
        
        // Mouse look
        if (yawVel !== 0 || pitchVel !== 0) {
            camera._yaw += yawVel;
            camera._pitch += pitchVel;
            
            // Clamp pitch
            const maxP = Math.PI / 2 - 0.01;
            if (camera._pitch > maxP) camera._pitch = maxP;
            if (camera._pitch < -maxP) camera._pitch = -maxP;
            
            // Rebuild target
            const px = camera.position.x;
            const py = camera.position.y;
            const pz = camera.position.z;
            camera.target.x = px + Math.sin(camera._yaw) * Math.cos(camera._pitch);
            camera.target.y = py + Math.sin(camera._pitch);
            camera.target.z = pz + Math.cos(camera._yaw) * Math.cos(camera._pitch);
            
            // Decay
            yawVel *= inertia;
            pitchVel *= inertia;
            
            // Stop if below threshold
            if (Math.abs(yawVel) < lookThreshold) yawVel = 0;
            if (Math.abs(pitchVel) < lookThreshold) pitchVel = 0;
        }
        
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }
    
    // --- Setup ---
    if (!canvas.hasAttribute('tabindex')) {
        canvas.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
    }
    canvas.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    canvas.addEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
    canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerCancel);
    
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    
    // --- Cleanup ---
    return (): void => {
        canvas.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
        canvas.removeEventListener('keyup', onKeyUp);
        canvas.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointerDown);
        canvas.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
        canvas.removeEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
        canvas.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerCancel);
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
    };
}
```
